name: smtp-utf8-san-excluded-mailbox-diff-local-invalid
description: Mailbox-form rfc822Name exclusions conservatively cover the entire domain when applied to a SmtpUTF8Mailbox SAN: a different local-part at the same domain must still be rejected.
notes: Botan's matcher cannot grant mailbox-form precision against SmtpUTF8Mailbox; treating it as covering the whole domain is the conservative choice.

This also matches the strict-RFC-9549 reading, in which a mailbox-form rfc822 constraint applied to a SmtpUTF8Mailbox SAN is compared on the domain only. The two readings agree on this case (same domain, exclusion applies).
